sentences.japanese: 教師は学生達の要求に屈した。
sentences.english: The teacher gave way to the students' demand.

sentences.japanese: 患者はただ自らの病気に屈して死ぬことがよくある。
sentences.english: Patients often die simply because they yield to their diseases.

sentences.japanese: 我々は彼らの要求に屈するわけにはいかない。
sentences.english: We must not give way to their demands.

sentences.japanese: ついに彼女は彼に屈して秘密を漏らした。
sentences.english: At last she gave way to him and broke a secret.

sentences.japanese: ついに、その共産主義者は手強い相手に屈した。
sentences.english: The communist gave in to his tough opponent at last.
